title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
 Prometteur is a leading global systems integrator and business transformation consulting organisation. Prometteur helps companies innovate and transform by leveraging its unique insights, differentiated services, and flexible partnering models. The company is among the Top mobile application development companies in India, and also a pioneer in web application development and Automation Testing. Prometteur has gained the trust of more than 300 offshore clients from 30\+ countries worldwide and has become a trustworthy software partner.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description:
   

  

 We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic Content Writer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong writing skills, a willingness to learn, and an interest in creating engaging content across digital platforms. Candidates with a technical, literature, or media background and exposure to iGaming or online gaming content will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Create high\-quality, engaging, and original content for blogs, websites, articles, and marketing materials
* Research industry\-related topics, especially in technology and online gaming/iGaming
* Edit and proofread content to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency
* Follow brand tone, style guidelines, and SEO best practices
* Collaborate with marketing, SEO, and design teams to develop content ideas
* Stay updated with content trends, digital marketing practices, and gaming industry updates


 Required Skills \& Qualifications:
   

  

* 1\-2 Year of experience in content writing
* Excellent written communication skills in English
* Ability to research topics and convert information into engaging content
* Basic understanding of SEO concepts is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and eagerness to learn Knowledge about writing blogs, webpages, business articles, whitepapers, etc., in brand style and format.
* Basic understanding of SEO and keywords usage.
* Understanding of content strategy, mapping, and branding.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks while collaborating smoothly with the design and marketing team.
* Experience in IT/SaaS/iGaming would be add\-on.


**Qualifications**
 Technical background (BE, BTech, or equivalent) OR
   

  

* Literature / Media background (MA in English, Mass Communication, Journalism, or related fields)
